svg.title: Target Vector Generation and Training Phase Diagram
svg.desc: Complete editable SVG reconstruction. Frame f01 contains the Target Vector Generation Phase: two gridded vector scatter plots connected by arrows and ellipses, a top M-steps bracket, and a dotted dataset box D listing unsafe prompts and nudity vectors. Frame f02 contains the Training Phase: prompt text, two Text Encoder icons, dashed and solid directional arrows, unsafe/safe vector groups, target/original/neutral vector labels, loss annotations, and the dashed connection from D into the training targets. The layout uses horizontal symmetry across pipeline stages and vertical alignment between top generated vectors and bottom training vectors.

g.desc: First generated target vector plot: grid centered at origin, blue circles and red crosses in upper right, several green target vectors downward from origin, and colored safe/unsafe/nudity vectors from the origin.

Second selected safe vector plot: grid centered at origin with safe vector on the positive side, generated target vectors sweeping from left toward upper right, and unsafe/nudity vectors labeled to the right.
